name: hash_identifier
description: Identify what algorithm produced a hash string (MD5, SHA-family, bcrypt, Argon2, etc.) based on its length/format. Can also identify multiple hashes at once, get an AI-written analysis of a hash's characteristics, or look up general info about a named hash algorithm.

action.description: identify: detect the type of one hash. identify_batch: detect types for multiple hashes at once. analyze: AI-written deep-dive on one hash's characteristics. algorithm_info: general info about a named algorithm (e.g. 'SHA256', 'bcrypt').

hash.description: A single hash string. Required for identify and analyze.

hashes.description: A list of hash strings. Required for action='identify_batch'.

hash_type.description: A named hash algorithm (e.g. 'MD5', 'SHA256', 'bcrypt', 'Argon2'). Required for action='algorithm_info'.
